title: Fix Inspector Menu Shortcut Crash
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #123896

## Additional information

The Inspector dock's "resource extra" `MenuButton` popup (New Resource / Load
Resource / Save / Save As / Edit Resource from Clipboard / Copy Resource /
Show in FileSystem / Open Documentation / Make Resource Built-In) has several
items bound to a keyboard shortcut. `MenuButton::shortcut_input()` correctly
checks `PopupMenu::is_item_disabled()` before running the bound action, via
`PopupMenu::activate_item_by_event()` -- but that check only reflects
whatever disabled state was last written to that specific item.

Most items (Save, Save As, Copy Resource, Make Resource Built-In, Open
Documentation) already had their disabled state recomputed on every Inspector
selection change, in `InspectorDock::update()`. "Show in FileSystem" and
"Edit Resource from Clipboard" were the exception: their disabled state was
only recomputed when the popup was actually opened
(`_prepare_resource_extra_popup()`, tied to the button's `about_to_popup`
signal). So a pure keyboard shortcut press, without ever opening the popup
for the current selection, could activate "Show in FileSystem" while it was
actually invalid for the current selection (for example, while the Inspector
is showing a `Node` rather than a `Resource`) -- crashing with:

```
ERROR: Condition "current_res.is_null()" is true.
   at: _menu_option_confirm (editor/docks/inspector_dock.cpp:108)
```

This PR:
- Adds a single `_is_menu_option_enabled(int p_option)` predicate, the one
  place that decides whether a given resource-extra-popup option is valid
  right now.
- Uses it to compute every relevant item's disabled state, via a small
  `_update_resource_extra_popup_items()` helper that iterates the popup's
  own items (`get_item_count()` / `get_item_id()`) rather than hand-listing
  option IDs a second time -- called from both `update()` (on every
  selection change) and `_prepare_resource_extra_popup()` (on popup open),
  so all items are now refreshed consistently and at the same two points.
- Calls it again as an early-return guard at the very top of
  `_menu_option_confirm()`, so none of these options can actually run while
  invalid, regardless of what any `PopupMenu` item's disabled flag happens
  to say at the moment it's invoked -- closing the gap described above for
  good, rather than only for this one option.

I tested this by assigning a keyboard shortcut to "Property Editor > Show in
FileSystem" in Editor Settings, selecting a plain `Node` in a scene (so the
Inspector shows a `Node`, not a `Resource`), and pressing the shortcut
without ever opening the popup first. Before this PR, that reliably crashed
with the error above; after, it's a silent no-op, matching the item's own
(now consistently up to date) disabled appearance.

### Use of AI

I used Claude (Anthropic's AI coding assistant, via Claude Code) throughout
this fix: to search and read the relevant engine source
(`MenuButton::shortcut_input`, `PopupMenu::activate_item_by_event`,
`InspectorDock::update()` / `_prepare_resource_extra_popup()`) and pin down
the exact root cause described above, to draft the `_is_menu_option_enabled()`
/ `_update_resource_extra_popup_items()` refactor, and to iterate on
simplifying it (e.g. replacing a hand-written list of option IDs with
iterating the popup's actual items). I reviewed, tested, and adjusted the
resulting change myself before opening this PR; the final code and the
analysis above are my own understanding of the bug, not taken as-is from the
assistant.
